source: Curated from PoE Wiki, PoEDB, Maxroll crafting guides. No invented crafts.

operators.name: Eldritch Chaos Orb
operators.requires: Eldritch implicits with one side dominant
operators.notes: Does not preserve prefix/suffix count. Fractured mods on the rolled side stay. Standard cheap way to finish resists after defence prefixes are done.

operators.name: Eldritch Exalted Orb
operators.notes: Often paired with bench mod-blocking + Eldritch Annul.

operators.name: Eldritch Ichor / Ember
operators.effect: Apply Eater (Ichor) or Exarch (Ember) implicits; higher tier = dominant side for Eldritch currency

operators.name: Influence Exalted Orb (Conqueror / Shaper / Elder)
operators.effect: Adds that influence to a rare item and a new influence modifier
operators.notes: Planner compares orb EV vs buying an already-influenced base (INFLUENCED_BASE_PREMIUM). Eldritch ichor/ember is a separate system.

operators.name: Veiled Chaos Orb
operators.effect: Reforges a rare item with new random modifiers including a veiled modifier

operators.name: Veiled Exalted Orb
operators.effect: Removes a random modifier and adds a veiled modifier

operators.name: Dense Fossil (defence)
operators.effect: More likely Defence modifiers; no Life modifiers
operators.use: ES/Armour/Evasion prefixes on armour — common cheap alternative to metacraft harvest for multi-ES chests

operators.name: Harvest Reforge including X
operators.notes: Use with metacraft. Prefer Eldritch Chaos for suffix finishing on armour when prefixes are done.

operators.name: Betrayal Aisling / Jun unveil
operators.effect: Unveil veiled modifiers; outcomes in mods-unveiled.json

operators.name: Beastcrafting — Split / Black Morrigan
operators.effect: Split rare into copies; 6-link recipes exist
operators.notes: Full recipe table not in RePoE — see PoEDB Bestiary

operators.name: Recombinators
operators.effect: Combine two items; inherit mods by rules
operators.notes: Exclusive-mod tables incomplete in this dump

operators.name: Buy on trade
operators.effect: If expected craft cost >> market price for similar items, buy instead

dominance_rules.exarch_dominant: Ember tier > Ichor tier → Eldritch currency affects PREFIXES
dominance_rules.eater_dominant: Ichor tier > Ember tier → Eldritch currency affects SUFFIXES
dominance_rules.tied: Same tier → neither dominant; Eldritch currency cannot be used

recommended_patterns.name: Defence prefixes → Eldritch Chaos suffixes
steps: Roll defence prefixes (Deafening Woe / Dense Fossil) until usable — do NOT metacraft-hunt exact T1
Apply Eldritch Ichor so Eater is dominant (prefixes safe)
Spam Eldritch Chaos Orb until desired resists/attributes on suffixes
Finish implicits with Ember/Ichor as needed
recommended_patterns.applies_when: Body Armour / Boots / Gloves / Helmet with multiple defence prefixes + resist suffixes

recommended_patterns.name: Essence fish any-of family → metacraft harvest sibling
steps: Essence guarantee + fish any harvest-family mod
Lock that side → Harvest reforge to fill open slot
recommended_patterns.applies_when: Weapon / jewellery where Eldritch currency is unavailable
